summary.text: Brandon Achor, a Republican from Maumelle, represents Arkansas House District 71, which includes Maumelle and the surrounding north-central area of Pulaski County, and is serving his second term.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's profile, he was born and raised in Maumelle and attended the University of Arkansas at Fayetteville to study biochemistry.
Achor and his wife, Kaley, co-own several independent community pharmacies across central and rural eastern Arkansas, and the House lists his occupation as pharmacist.
